name: tick_direction_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, institutional TWAP and momentum algorithms execute directional orders over multiple 5-second bars, imprinting a persistent bias in bar-by-bar close direction. When >62% of the last 3 minutes of 5-second bars close higher (tick_dir_ratio > 0.62) and this ratio is accelerating, large buy-side flow is continuously absorbing sell-side liquidity — market makers short gamma via ATM options must delta-hedge by buying the index in the same direction, compounding the upward pressure. We enter 30-60 seconds into this dominance phase, before the signal becomes visible on 1-minute charts, and ride the institutional order completion window (30-90 seconds). The converse applies for persistent downtick dominance signaling sell-side absorption.

indicators.name: tick_dir_ratio_36
indicators.purpose: Fraction of 5s bars closing up over 3 minutes (36 bars). Chosen at 3 min because it captures a meaningful institutional TWAP slice — long enough to distinguish sustained order flow from noise (18+ up-bars out of 36 is statistically significant), but short enough to lead our 30-90s hold time by the needed 1-2 minutes. The original used 1-min tick_ratio feeding into EMA(5) = ~5-min effective lookback on 1-min bars with 2-5 min hold; we compress proportionally to 3 min for our shorter hold.

indicators.name: tick_dir_momentum_24
indicators.purpose: Acceleration of tick direction ratio: change in the rolling ratio over the past 2 minutes (24 bars). The original computed tick_ratio_ema[t] - tick_ratio_ema[t-3] on 1-min bars (3-min lookback). We use a 2-min lag (24 bars) on our already-smoothed 36-bar ratio — this detects the phase where uptick dominance is building, not just sustained, giving earlier entry into the institutional order flow window.

indicators.name: price_roc_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute price rate of change to confirm NIFTY is actually moving in the direction of the tick signal. Scaled from original's 3-bar ROC on 1-min bars (3 min) to 1 min (12 bars) because with a 30-90s hold, we need price confirmation at the same 1-min timescale, not 3-min. This filters cases where tick ratio is elevated but price is flat (range-bound noise).

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as a trend filter: buy CE only when NIFTY is above VWAP (institutions net buying since open), buy PE only when below. No scaling needed — cumulative measure from session open. Direct translation of original's VWAP filter (close > VWAP for longs, < VWAP for shorts).

conditions: price_roc_12 > price_roc_threshold (default 0.0003, i.e. +3 bps in 1 min)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions met on current 5s bar; uptick dominance is sustained and accelerating with price confirming

buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions met on current 5s bar; downtick dominance is sustained and accelerating with price confirming

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). If NIFTY reverses 8 spot points within 30-90s, the tick direction signal has definitively failed — institutional order flow has reversed or completed. Typical 30s NIFTY move is 2-5 option pts, so 4 pts stop sits at the upper end of typical noise, preventing stop-hunting while exiting genuine reversals.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points (~12 NIFTY spot points). A sustained tick direction signal with institutional flow behind it typically drives 10-20 spot point moves within 1-2 min; 6 option pts captures ~50% of the lower end of that range. Gives 1:1.5 R:R with 4-pt stop — viable with 55%+ win rate.

filters.vix_filter: none (VIX not used — tick direction works across vol regimes; high VIX actually improves signal as institutional hedging is more directional)
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; skip first 5 minutes of session (09:15-09:20) to avoid opening auction noise
filters.volume_filter: price_roc_12 > threshold acts as implicit volume/momentum filter
filters.trend_filter: session VWAP alignment (close vs VWAP) ensures trade direction matches broader intraday trend
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — bar-direction approximation of tick ratio is a proxy that degrades if 5s bars become noisier or if algo diversity increases. Core order-flow imbalance thesis remains valid on NIFTY as long as institutional TWAP participation is high.

adaptation_notes: Original tracked actual uptick/downtick counts from trade tape on NIFTY50 constituent stocks. At index level on 5-second bars, each bar's close direction (close > prev_close) serves as a tick direction proxy — at 5s resolution each bar represents ~50-200 actual ticks, making the direction of close a reliable aggregated tick signal. The EMA smoothing of 1-min tick ratios (original's EMA-5 on 1-min bars) is replaced by a rolling 36-bar fraction on raw 5s bars — equivalent information, higher temporal resolution. VWAP filter, price ROC confirmation, and momentum acceleration checks are preserved semantically. Hold time compressed 2-5x (from 2-5 min to 30-90s) by removing multi-minute persistence requirement that was needed on noisy equity stocks but is unnecessary on the liquid NIFTY index.
weaknesses: Bar close direction is a noisy proxy for true tick direction — a single large print can change a bar's close without reflecting the underlying order flow majority
NIFTY index volume is less informative than individual stock volume; the implicit volume filter (price_roc_12) may miss high-tick-count low-price-move bars
No VIX regime filter means strategy fires in both trending and volatile sessions; performance will vary significantly across regime types
